svg.title: Batch known steps and checkpoint a workflow
svg.desc: A batch runs 1–64 supported steps sequentially and stops at the first error. Each successful step returns a receipt. Failures retain indexed completed-step results and a failed-step record through CLI JSON errors, SDK errors and MCP structured content; exit codes and MCP error status remain failures. A failed step marked dispatched may already have changed the site. before and after use string conditions from wait: js, url, text, selector or gone. Steps name their target tab in args and use the parent’s agent/task and deadline. batch and workflow are coordinators, so they do not take a top-level CLI --tab. They are individual scheduler operations, not an atomic transaction across agents. Definitions are limited to 256 KiB and collected results to 4 MiB. Large outputs should go to files or use smaller observation budgets.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
